snippet.title: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko‘s Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD- | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A thousand adventures in one! — Discover the roots of the Mystery Dungeon series!

Originally released only in Japan, the first entry in the Mystery Dungeon series and prequel to Torneko: The Last Hope is finally making its international debut! Packed with the challenge, tension, and rewarding gameplay of a classic roguelike adventure, this is a journey we're excited for a new generation of players take on!

Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko‘s Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD- will be available throughout the day on:
Nintendo Switch™ 2
Nintendo Switch™
PlayStation®5
XBOX Series X|S
Steam®
